mapper.select: SELECT '1' AS statusBatch, T1.PROD_ID AS prodId, T1.PROD_NAME AS prodName, '表外' AS surfaceInOut, '阳光理财' AS prodBrand, ifnull(T1.PROD_STAGE,0) AS prodStage, T1.RAISE_CCY AS raiseCcy, T1.COOPERATION_NAME AS cooperationName, T1.RAISE_AMT_PLAN AS raiseAmtPlan, T1.SALE_AMT_STR AS saleAmtStr, T1.RAISE_VDATE AS raiseVdate, T1.RAISE_ENDDATE AS raiseEnddate, T1.CASH_PRIN_CCY AS cashPrinCcy, T1.CASH_PROF_CCY AS cashProfCcy, T1.VDATE AS vdate, T1.MDATE AS mdate, T1.LOW_YIELD AS lowYield, T1.HIGH_YIELD AS highYield, T1.IS_CONSTRACTE AS isConstracte, T1.RISK_LEVEL AS riskLevel, '银行' AS prodManagePattern, T1.CONT_MODE AS contMode, T1.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType, '全国' AS prodSalebankName, T1.OPERATE_MODE AS operateMode, T1.CMMODE AS cmmode, T1.TERM_RIGHT_FLAG AS termRightFlag, T1.SALE_TYPE AS invAssetType, T1.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS customerType, T1.INVEST_ARAE AS investArae, '91110000100011743X' AS bankMark , STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AS dateStatus, DATA_SOURCE AS groupId FROM CHB_PRD_BASEINFO T1 WHERE T1.STATUS != 'D'
select T1.PROD_ID AS prodId, T1.CCY As ccy, sum(T1.TRADE_PRINCE) totalAmt FROM CHB_PRD_DEAL T1 join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO T2 on T1.PROD_ID=T2.PROD_ID where T1.TRADE_TYPE='01' GROUP BY T1.PROD_ID,T1.CCY
SELECT REGIST_SEQNO AS registSeqno FROM CHB_FINANCE_PRODUCTS_SUB WHERE DATE_STATUS = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
